news.title: Aspen Aerogels Sets Q2 2025 Earnings Release
news.text: Aspen Aerogels scheduled second-quarter 2025 results for July 31 with a post-close conference call.

news.title: Commercial Production Update Highlights Silicon-28 Progress
news.text: ASP Isotopes reported enriching Silicon-28 intermediate product to 99% purity and raised annual capacity guidance.

news.title: New Aerogel Products Target Energy Storage Market
news.text: Aspen Aerogels launched an aerogel insulation line for energy storage applications, broadening its energy transition offerings.

news.title: ASP Isotopes Prices $60 Million Offering
news.text: The company priced a $60 million underwritten registered direct stock offering to fund isotope expansion.

news.title: South African Regulator Clears Renergen Acquisition
news.text: The Competition Commission of South Africa approved ASP Isotopes' offer for Renergen Limited.

news.title: IsoBio Raises Seed Funding with ASP Support
news.text: ASP Isotopes and IsoBio announced seed financing to advance antibody-isotope conjugate development.

news.title: Dual Listing on Johannesburg Exchange Expected
news.text: ASP Isotopes said it anticipated commencing a secondary listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

news.title: Joint Venture Planned with Fermi America
news.text: ASP Isotopes and Quantum Leap Energy signed an MOU with Fermi America to collaborate on advanced nuclear fuel facilities in Texas.

news.title: Investors Tour South African Isotope Plants
news.text: The company hosted South African investors ahead of its JSE listing and updated progress on isotope production plants.

news.title: Renergen Merger Completion Announced
news.text: ASP Isotopes completed the Renergen merger, giving the partner a majority stake in the business.

news.title: Industry Veteran Ralph Hunter Joins Board
news.text: ASP Isotopes added nuclear power veteran Ralph Hunter to its board and to Quantum Leap Energy's board of managers.

news.title: Secondary Listing on JSE Successfully Launched
news.text: The company confirmed the commencement of trading on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

news.title: Leadership Changes Announced
news.text: ASP Isotopes detailed executive management changes at both the parent company and Quantum Leap Energy effective October 2025.

news.title: Purchase Order Secured for Enriched Barium-137
news.text: The company received a purchase order from a U.S. customer for enriched Barium-137.

news.title: Institutional Investor Access Event Planned
news.text: ASP Isotopes scheduled an institutional investor event in South Africa for November 11-13.

news.title: Public Offering of Common Stock Proposed
news.text: The company announced plans for a public offering of common stock to fund expansion.

news.title: $210 Million Public Offering Priced
news.text: ASP Isotopes priced a public offering of 17.17 million shares, raising approximately $210 million.

news.title: Cantor Fitzgerald Starts Coverage at Overweight
news.text: Cantor Fitzgerald initiated coverage with an Overweight rating and $12 price target, citing isotope market potential.

news.title: Quantum Leap Completes One 30 Seven Asset Acquisition
news.text: Quantum Leap Energy, an ASP subsidiary, acquired One 30 Seven assets to address water-soluble nuclear waste processing.
